breadcrumbs.name: RFID Pallet Tags — Automated Dock-door Identification & Warehouse Tracking

summary: UHF RFID pallet tags enable automated identification of palletized goods at dock doors, warehouse portals and storage locations. Mount a rugged tag on each pallet and fixed readers automatically log every pallet movement — receiving, put-away, picking, shipping and cross-docking — without manual scanning.
